description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions related to gateway session timeouts, URL building, and URL rewriting in the 'ai.openclaw.app.gateway' package using the JUnit testing framework.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTimeoutTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for functions related to gateway session timeouts, URL formatting, and URL manipulation within the gateway package.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests that the function correctly formats a gateway authority string with IPv6 brackets and port.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests the construction of WebSocket URLs with IPv6 brackets and different TLS settings.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_normalizesPersistedBracketedIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests URL normalization behavior when provided with already bracketed IPv6 hosts.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesFloorWhenMissingOrTooSmall
methods.description: Tests that the timeout resolution function defaults or floors values when input is missing or too small.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesInvokeBudgetWithinBounds
methods.description: Tests that the function caps the timeout at specified bounds.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_capsAtUpperBound
methods.description: Ensures the timeout does not exceed upper limits when input is large.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesTerminalCapabilitySegment
methods.description: Tests URL rewriting to replace the capability segment in the URL path.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesWhenQueryAndFragmentPresent
methods.description: Tests that URL rewriting preserves query parameters and fragment when present.
